name: new-term-radar
description: Three skills that find the names of new AI models, products and repositories as they surface, and size the search terms behind them with Google Ads volume and DataForSEO Trends, an estimate of Google search interest.

monid_api_key.title: Monid API key
monid_api_key.description: Pays for the radar's lookups: X posts, Google Ads volumes, DataForSEO Trends, plus the site ratings, the traffic of a new seller and the AdSense portfolios. recent_leads works without it. A key: https://monid.ai

aisa_api_key.title: AIsa API key (optional)
aisa_api_key.description: Optional: the second door for Google's own numbers. It answers the same readings when Monid's answer does not come back. A key: https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu (referral link)

openai_api_key.title: Model gateway API key
openai_api_key.description: The model's calls: the name judge, the keyword table's phrases, the pains, the sellers. An OpenAI-compatible API; the key comes from your own gateway.
